changelog: Complete Windows x64 installer with CMS, ScriptIT, Pikgen, Vidnets and UploadIT runtimes.
Pikgen profile-limit import and owned-browser cleanup fixed; one shared interactive browser profile remains enforced.
Admin and partner channel controls, measured title-format research and saved model routing updates.
Application Updates checks public metadata and opens approved GitHub installer downloads without a shared embedded token.
Application and engine archive integrity enabled; local keys, cookies, owner data and admin development folders excluded.
Unsigned Windows build. Install when production is idle; preserve your existing workspace.
Docker backend build and isolated non-root runtime verified in private Linux CI. Windows GUI and IX/browser integrations remain native.
